title: WPSS/547/2019 of PANKAJ SEMWAL Vs STATE OF UTTARAKHAND

paras.text:
WPSS No.547 of 2019
Honíble Manoj K. Tiwari, J.
Mr. Manish Lohani, Advocate for the
petitioner.
Mr. M.C. Tewari, Deputy Advocate
General for the State of Uttarakhand.
Heard learned counsel for the parties.
According to the petitioner, he was
engaged on Daily Wages as driver through
P.R.D. in District Employment Office, Tehri
Garhwal. His grievance is that, after
completing more than 5 years continuous
satisfactory service as Driver in District
Employment Office, Tehri Garhwal, the
District Employment Officer had asked the
petitioner to go back to P.R.D. Subsequently,
he requested the Zila Yuva Kalyan & Prantiya
Rakshak Dal Adhikari, Tehri Garhwal to
supply another Driver. This, according to the
petitioner, is unjust, inasmuch as, one
temporary employee cannot be replaced by
another.
Since work and post is available in
District Employment Office, Tehri Garhwal,
as is apparent by the letter dated 24.05.2018
written by District Employment Officer, Tehri
Garhwal to supply another Driver, and in the
absence of any adverse material, there is no
justification for asking the petitioner to go
back.
Having regard to the facts &
circumstances of the case and to meet the
ends of justice, the writ petition is disposed of
with liberty to the petitioner to make a
representation to the District Employment
Officer, Tehri Garhwal within a period of two
weeks from today. In case such a
representation is filed within the stipulated
period, the District Employment Officer, Tehri
Garhwal shall consider and take decision on
the petitionerís representation, in accordance
with law, and shall pass a reasoned and

speaking order within a period of eight weeks
from the date of receipt of representation
alongwith a certified copy of this order.
